text_block_list.text:
During a break in the Summer Training 
Camp, El Condor Pasa and the others took 
part in a local summer festival held at 
the camp grounds.

While the other Umamusume rest after 
dancing themselves tired... El Condor Pasa 
continues dancing all by herself just to 
keep everyone entertained.

And so, El Condor Pasa realizes what that 
"special power" Silence Suzuka mentioned 
really is.

Winning, performing—it was all to 
entertain others... For that sake, she 
could persevere through anything. She 
realized that was her very own "power."

El Condor Pasa wishing to entertain 
everyone. Together with the Trainer, she 
said a prayer to her mask, the very symbol 
of that desire.
